messages:
alex: kicking off cleanup for the AcmeCorp POC — we need a short runbook to revoke hosted API keys, tear down the dedicated GPU pool, and confirm no customer data remains in caches/logs. objective: complete by EOD Thurs.

mira: can we get a checklist? i want to confirm data retention window and whether any snapshots were taken.

kevin: I can do the dedicated pool drain + teardown. plan: scale down, wait for in-flight requests to finish, snapshot metrics, then delete pool. need a sign-off from sales/legal for retention hold.

infra_sre: proposed commands:
```
# revoke hosted API key
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"key_id":"acct-acme-poc-01"}'

# teardown dedicated pool (redwoodctl)
redwoodctl pools drain --pool-id pool-acme-poc --wait 600
redwoodctl pools delete --pool-id pool-acme-poc --force
```
We also need to clear prefix KV cache for the POC model shards: `redwoodctl cache invalidate --prefix "acme/poc/"`.

alex: perfect. mira — can you confirm whether AcmeCorp requested any logs or snapshots for retention/legal hold?

mira: they asked to keep a hashed audit trail for 90 days, but legal flagged potential GDPR export. emma-legal will confirm exact retention and what counts as PII.

emma-legal: confirm: AcmeCorp has a 30‑day retention by default in the contract, but they requested a 90‑day trial exception. we need an official datapoint from sales to approve >30 days. otherwise proceed with 30 days and document it. Also: if they put a legal hold, we cannot delete until release.

kevin: noted. I'll prepare the teardown but hold the delete step behind a manual approval gate. We can still revoke API keys immediately and schedule the pool delete pending legal.

alex: sounds good. order of ops suggestion: 1) revoke hosted API keys 2) mark pool as draining (no new sessions) 3) export metrics + snapshots if approved 4) invalidate caches and temporary storage 5) delete pool + clean up infra keys once legal clears.

infra_sre: add: rotate/wipe KMS access for customer-specific CMKs used in POC (if any). commands: `gcloud kms keys disable KEY_NAME` or `aws kms schedule-key-deletion --key-id KEY` depending on cloud. also check S3 buckets / object lifecycle.

mira: quick q on data in embeddings storage — do we store raw customer text anywhere?

infra_sre: embeddings backend stores vector blobs and a pointer to metadata. by default we strip raw input unless customer opted in. for this POC we did not opt-in, so no raw text should exist. i'll run a quick query to confirm.

sales_ops_bot: automated note: POC-acme: created on 2025-02-10, pools: pool-acme-poc (g4dn), hosted-keys: acct-acme-poc-01.

kevin: assigning tasks — @infra_sre to revoke hosted key + invalidate caches, @kevin to set pool to draining and capture metrics, @mira to confirm snapshots/log exports, @emma-legal to confirm retention. i'll add the manual approval after legal.

infra_sre: starting key revoke now. posting results when done. :white_check_mark:

alex: thanks — also note cost reconciliation: we should run a final usage calc and bill any overages to the POC cost center. finance will reconcile.

mira: follow-up: where should we store the teardown audit? link to central bucket?

infra_sre: store audit in s3://redwood-poc-audits/acme/ with restricted ACLs. I'll push a minimal audit: timestamps, actions, operator. sample entry: `2025-03-12T15:23Z revoke-key acct-acme-poc-01 by infra_sre`

emma-legal: if you hit a legal hold, tag the audit record and email counsel. do not delete artifact until release.

kevin: update: pool drain started at 1818881670, waiting for active sessions to drop below 2. expected finish ~20m.

infra_sre: revoke response: `{ "status": "success", "key_id": "acct-acme-poc-01", "revoked_by": "infra_sre", "time": "2025-03-12T15:25:02Z" }`. cache invalidation queued.

mira: confirmed: no snapshots requested by customer. proceed with default retention 30 days unless legal instructs otherwise.

kevin: pool drain complete at 1818881800. taking metrics snapshot and uploading to s3. then I'll hold delete pending legal OK.

alex: outstanding: confirm embeddings safe, confirm no raw logs in S3 + confirm KMS keys state. infra_sre, can you post final checklist when done?

infra_sre: checklist complete: embeddings no-raw-data (verified), logs: rotated and archived (no raw text), KMS: no customer CMK in use -> nothing to disable. audit log at s3://redwood-poc-audits/acme/1818881234-cleanup.json. leaving pool deletion pending legal. :lock:

emma-legal: legal approves default 30-day retention. no hold. you are cleared to delete pool and remove snapshots after 30 days.

kevin: proceeding to delete pool now. final delete command ran at 1818881888: `redwoodctl pools delete --pool-id pool-acme-poc --force`.

alex: great work everyone. please paste the final audit entry and close the ticket. :tada:

infra_sre: final audit entry: `{"poC":"acme","actions":[{"time":"2025-03-12T15:25:02Z","action":"revoke-key","by":"infra_sre"},{"time":"2025-03-12T15:58:08Z","action":"invalidate-cache","by":"infra_sre"},{"time":"2025-03-12T16:11:28Z","action":"pool-delete","by":"kevin"}],"retention_days":"30"}`. closing thread.
